rules.pre_revenue: revenue under $25M over four quarters and operating income ≤ 0 (a pipeline no filing prices)
rules.pre_profit: operating income ≤ 0 over four quarters and revenue growth ≥ 10%

rules.decline: operating income ≤ 0 with growth under 10%, or revenue falling over 1 and 3 years
rules.financial: SIC of a bank or insurer

implied_return.note: The yearly return a buyer at today's price earns if each model's assumptions hold (an implied cost of capital). Above the cost of equity: the price leaves room; below: the price already asks for more than the models deliver.

wacc.formula: WACC = wₑ × kₑ + w_d × k_d × (1 − t);  kₑ = r_f + β × ERP
steps: β (Blume-adjusted) = 0.67 × raw β 0.40 + 0.33 = 0.60  (61 weekly returns vs SPY, R² 0.02)
k_d = 7.10%  (10-year Treasury + 2% (no rate on file)); after tax 7.10% × (1 − 21%) = 5.61%

methods.formula: Value per share = peer median P/E × EPS
methods.fit: EPS is positive ($0.59 over four quarters), and 6 peers (SIC 8200) have the multiple.

methods.formula: Value per share = weighted peer median P/E × EPS; weight of a peer's multiple = size weight × recency weight
steps: 6 peers, 106 observations (today and every quarter since 2022); the weights amount to 5.8 equal peers

medians: every peer alike, today only (the plain median) 12.0x; by market value 12.2x; by revenue 12.0x; by trading value 12.1x; by recency only (quarters since 2022, half-life one year) 17.1x; all together 17.1x
inputs: shares of the peers' market value, revenue and trading value
assumptions: geometric mean of the peer's shares of market value, revenue and trading value
an assumption: the largest peer weighs most but is never the whole answer
an assumption: last year's quarters count half
median daily close × volume, last 63 sessions
methods.fit: EPS is positive ($0.59 over four quarters), and 6 peers (SIC 8200) have the multiple. Weighting the peers by market value, revenue and trading value, and their quarters by recency, keeps small, thinly traded peers and old prices from moving the multiple as much.

methods.formula: Value per share = median P/E of the peers like it × EPS
steps: window ladder, the first with six or more peers: tight: 0 peers; medium: 6 peers
medium window: same 3-digit SIC, profitable or not alike, revenue 1/10–10×, growth and margin within 15 points
inputs: four quarters vs the four before; operating income ÷ revenue
assumptions: fixed in app/peer_tiers.py before any result was seen
methods.fit: EPS is positive ($0.59 over four quarters), and 6 peers (SIC 8200) have the multiple. Here only the peers like it count: the same industry and stage, a similar size, growth and operating margin.

methods.formula: Value = book + Σ (ROEₜ − kₑ) × Bookₜ₋₁ ÷ (1 + kₑ)ᵗ over 10 years; ROE fades linearly to kₑ; half of earnings retained
methods.fit: Equity is positive ($1.02M) and so is net income ($1.22M), so the return it earns on book value can be compared with what shareholders require.

methods.formula: Not a model of value: an outside or market figure shown for comparison
methods.fit: Shown for comparison; not part of the stage-weighted value.

methods.formula: Value per share = owner earnings × (1 + g) ÷ (kₑ − g) ÷ shares; owner earnings = net income + D&A − capex
methods.fit: Owner earnings are positive ($1.22M = net income + D&A − capex), and at the pre-revenue stage today's cash earnings are a sound base.

methods.formula: Value per share = (equity − goodwill − intangibles) ÷ shares, floored at 0; low end × 0.8
assumptions: an assumption (XBRL frames carry no asset-level haircuts)
methods.fit: At the pre-revenue stage what its assets would fetch matters; tangible book is $0.49 a share.

methods.formula: Net cash per share = (cash − debt − other claims) ÷ diluted shares, floored at 0
steps: Market-implied value of the pipeline (EV) = market value − net cash = $22.02M − $1.11M = $20.91M
assumptions: a floor: no filing prices a drug trial or an unlaunched product
methods.fit: It is pre-revenue (— of revenue over four quarters, with an operating loss): its cash is the one solid number, and the rest of the price is a bet on its pipeline.

methods.formula: Stage-weighted value = Σ weight × central value of the stage's methods (weights renormalized over the methods available)
assumptions: fixed by stage before any result was seen (base_rates.STAGES)
methods.fit: Its stage is “Pre-revenue” — revenue not reported over four quarters, operating income ≤ 0 — which fixes these methods and their weights in advance.

methods.formula: Graham number = √(22.5 × EPS × book value per share);  22.5 = a P/E of 15 × a P/B of 1.5
assumptions: Benjamin Graham, The Intelligent Investor (1949; 1973 edition, ch. 14)
methods.fit: It has positive earnings and book value, the two things Graham asked a defensive investor to pay for — and to pay little for.
